text_bundle.body:
Three questions keep self-employed women from taking a real leave: Will I get paid? Who takes care of my clients? Can I actually step away?

I help self employed women navigate FAMLI, set up client coverage, and build a money plan for their leave.

“Because of you, my business hasn’t missed a beat through all of this.” 
- Danielle

I’m opening 3 one on one spots. Tap Apply Now to fill out the application. I read every one myself and reach out personally if it’s a fit.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the State of Colorado or the FAMLI Division. Benefit amounts depend on eligibility and earnings. Learn more at famli.colorado.gov.
